broadcast-burgundy.$description: Broadcast Burgundy — Hero backgrounds, primary dark surface — creates the theater-dark immersion that makes coral CTAs read as on-air signals

on-air-coral.$description: On-Air Coral — Primary CTA buttons, active section labels — the single vivid signal against deep burgundy dark

hot-take-red.$description: Hot Take Red — Inline text highlights, secondary accent emphasis in body copy

plum-mid.$description: Plum Mid — Nav hover states, secondary button backgrounds — one step lighter than Broadcast Burgundy for interactive depth

deep-violet.$description: Deep Violet — Inline links and callout text in light sections — a cool contrast to the otherwise warm palette

soft-violet.$description: Soft Violet — Underlord AI feature accent — used on AI chat interface send button

pale-peach.$description: Pale Peach — Card backgrounds for feature cards in warm sections

blush-mist.$description: Blush Mist — Card backgrounds for testimonial and feature content cards in light sections

studio-black.$description: Studio Black — Deepest background layer, nav overlay backgrounds

ink-dark.$description: Ink Dark — Body text, nav text — used across all surfaces

warm-parchment.$description: Warm Parchment — Light section page backgrounds, button text on dark — deliberately off-white to maintain warmth against burgundy

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Button text on coral CTAs, card surfaces in chat UI

dusty-rose.$description: Dusty Rose — Secondary body text, de-emphasized labels on dark surfaces

border-mauve.$description: Border Mauve — Card borders, dividers, input borders on dark surfaces

fog-gray.$description: Fog Gray — Borders and dividers on light surfaces, button borders

muted-plum.$description: Muted Plum — Mid-dark card backgrounds in dark sections

steel-mauve.$description: Steel Mauve — Shadows, secondary text on light surfaces

booton.$description: Primary workhorse across UI — nav, body copy, buttons, captions, and feature labels. Weight 600 for subheadings and card titles; weight 400 for body and nav. The custom design gives it a warmth that distinguishes it from commodity grotesques like Inter.

gamuth-display.$description: Hero and section headings only. A custom editorial serif — the signature choice that marks Descript as a content creation tool, not enterprise SaaS. Weight 400 at 88px is confident restraint; most SaaS hero fonts lean heavy.

brett.$description: Section eyebrow labels only (e.g. 'AI VIDEO EDITOR', 'AI VIDEO AGENT'). Wide 0.04em tracking mimics broadcast chyron or print section slugs — the only place positive letter-spacing appears in the system.
